name: Simulation
signals: The problem spells out the steps; just do them carefully

name: Digit math
signals: Work with the digits of a number: reverse, sum, palindrome

name: Number theory basics
signals: Divisibility, GCD, primes, multiples
complexity: Euclid O(log n), sieve O(n log log n)

name: Recursion
signals: Problem defined in terms of a smaller version of itself
complexity: calls × work per call; stack = depth

name: Memoization
signals: Recursion that recomputes the same subproblem

name: Divide & conquer
signals: Split in halves, solve, combine (fast power, merge sort)
complexity: often O(log n) or O(n log n)

name: Hash map / set
signals: Seen before? counting, pairs summing to a target, grouping

name: Prefix sum
signals: Running totals, many range-sum queries, subarray sum equals k

name: Two pointers
signals: Sorted array, pairs/triplets, palindromes, in-place filtering

name: Sliding window
signals: Contiguous subarray/substring + longest/shortest/max/min

name: Cyclic sort
signals: Numbers in range 1..n, find missing/duplicate

name: Binary search
signals: Sorted input, find first/last, O(log n) required

name: Binary search on the answer
signals: Minimum capacity/speed such that…; monotonic yes/no check

name: Fast & slow pointers
signals: Linked-list cycle, middle, repeating sequences

name: In-place list reversal
signals: Reverse all or part of a linked list

name: Stack
signals: Matching brackets, nested structure, undo, expression evaluation

name: Monotonic stack
signals: Next greater/smaller element, spans, histograms

name: Backtracking
signals: All combinations/permutations/subsets, constraint puzzles

name: Tree DFS
signals: Depth, paths, subtree properties, combine answers from children

name: BFS
signals: Level by level, shortest path in unweighted graphs, minimum steps

name: Island traversal
signals: 2D grid, connected regions

name: Topological sort
signals: Dependencies, prerequisites, task ordering

name: Union-Find
signals: Dynamic connectivity, merge groups

name: Dijkstra
signals: Weighted shortest path, non-negative weights

name: Top-K / heap
signals: k largest/smallest/most frequent, streaming best

name: Two heaps
signals: Running median, balance two halves

name: K-way merge
signals: Merge k sorted lists/arrays

name: Merge intervals
signals: Overlapping ranges, scheduling

name: Greedy
signals: Local best choice is provably safe, often after sorting

name: Dynamic programming
signals: Number of ways, min/max cost, overlapping choices, greedy fails

name: Trie
signals: Prefix search, autocomplete, word dictionary

name: Bit tricks
signals: Without extra space, XOR pairs, powers of two
